notes: Commit ef338f0 deals with the biggest friction from the 8.4 review, and the fixes show in the fresh screenshots. Fixed: the band's own tour no longer repeats every show. The Shows grid is gone for app tours, and each itinerary stop now carries its own progress ('80 of 400 fans · 120 more fans and it goes ahead'). phone-home.png went from about 2,500 px to 1,906 px. The fallback lines on Activity are marked 'now' instead of carrying a fake time. The wizard's fine print reads 'Your wallet asks you once and keeps a small deposit with each show. Nothing else is charged.' and the SOL figures sit behind 'How the devnet demo works' (4-route-preview.png). Registration says deposit instead of rent. The no-tour heading reads 'Your band is set up'. 'Tickets you hold: none' is gone from the band's wallet panel. The show page's purchase line no longer contradicts its totals. Partly fixed: the band record now says 'Shows played' and 'Paid out in all', but still shows '0 SOL' and a sample 'Tickets sold' count (phone-band.png). Running shows from the previous tour now stay in view, but they are merged into the new tour's route, map, days and drive totals as if they were one tour, and the wizard still says the dashboard 'then follows the new tour'. The dashboard's 'What happened' now has no fallback, so on a quiet RPC it shows only a sentence about devnet that never comes true. Still open: the wizard always starts in Berlin, the route cannot be edited and still has an unexplained '4 days off' and a double-back (4-route-preview.png); the price box and the fan's quantity box clamp on every keystroke; Approvals is still a permanent nav item that leads to a page with nothing to approve; the planner overwrites the band's sketch with no undo; phone Venues is still 10,508 px long; the Threshold tile still wraps '= 200 / fans'. The journey a musician needs (pitch, one CTA, four questions with defaults, route and money before booking, a booked dashboard that says what waits on whom, a show page with a share link, a working phone nav) now has only minor friction left. That passes the 8.5 bar, but the leftovers are spread across too many screens for 9.
issues: packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:72-85 + app/tour/new/page.tsx:143-146: still-running shows of the previous tour are merged into the latest tour's RunSummary, sorted by date and numbered from the earliest show. The map, itinerary and drive totals then draw one route across two tours, with legs and 'days off' between them, while 'tour on Solana ↗' links only the latest tour. Only tourId-1 is read, so older tours and finished tours stay unreachable, and the wizard still says 'the dashboard then follows the new tour'. Fix: show the earlier tour as its own collapsed block ('Still running from your last tour: 2 shows') with its own route, add a 'Past tours' list linked from Band record, and update the wizard sentence to match.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:19 + lib/book.ts (planFromAnswers): every band starts in Berlin and cannot change the route the agent proposes. In 4-route-preview.png Berlin is followed by '4 days off' before a 179 km drive, then Leipzig doubles back north to Hamburg, with no reason given and no way to drop a stop. The band chose 1,000 people, but every stop reads 'up to 800 fans (room 1,600)'. Fix: remember the last start city, say why a gap exists ('no free room in Leipzig before Nov 8'), allow per-stop toggles as on the Approvals route card, and put the 800-fan devnet cap into the route summary line.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:325-355,405-417: before the route, the booked dashboard still shows ten tiles, the five-step stepper plus five stat tiles, including 'At risk 0' and 'Cancelled 0'. The stepper marks 'Venues signed' as the current step while Hamburg is already confirmed. With the fallback removed, 'What happened' on the dashboard is a heading over one sentence ('still loading from devnet') that never resolves on a quiet RPC (7-booked-dashboard.png, phone-booked-dashboard.png). Fix: fold the stepper into the status banner, show At risk and Cancelled only when they are above 0, and hide 'What happened' until at least one event exists, keeping only the 'All activity →' link.

packages/web/src/app/band/page.tsx:79-90: the band record, which sits in the nav, still reads 'Paid out in all 0 SOL' and 'Tickets sold' / 'Avg per show' as on-chain sample counts. For an app tour that is 1/20 of the fans the dashboard reports, so the same band shows 240 fans on one page and 12 tickets on the next. 'profile ↗' still opens an explorer (phone-band.png). Fix: when the band's tours are in-app, show fans (×FANS_PER_TICKET) and euros, and rename the link 'public record ↗'.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:179 + app/show/page.tsx:254: the custom price still clamps on every keystroke (Number('') || 1), so clearing '20' to type '35' gives 1, then 13. The fan's quantity box behaves the same way (Math.max(1, Number(''))). These are the only two free-text inputs in the band and fan flows. Fix: keep the raw string in state, and clamp on blur or on Plan my tour / Buy.

packages/web/src/components/Shell.tsx:19 + components/Approvals.tsx:390: Approvals stays a permanent nav item for bands that booked in the wizard. The page only says there is nothing to approve (phone-approvals.png), and on a phone it costs a slot in the two-row nav. The agent flow still says 'The offer lapses in about 287s'. Fix: show Approvals in the nav only while something is pending or for agent-run bands, and format the countdown as '~5 min'.

packages/web/src/components/Feed.tsx:156 + app/page.tsx:416: both lines still speak chain ('the step-by-step story loads from devnet when it answers', 'still loading from devnet'), and the first one promises something that does not happen on a quiet RPC. On phone Activity (phone-feed.png) each of three groups holds exactly one line, but the line is hidden behind a tap with no preview. Fix: 'Where each show stands now. The full history appears here as it comes in.', and show single-item groups open (or keep the preview line at phone width).

packages/web/src/app/venues/page.tsx:229 + phone-venues.png: phone Venues is still one 10,508 px list of 35 cities, each with two venue rows, full-width '+ PLAN' buttons and a 'Plan city' pill, under three rows of filters. 'No venues match these filters.' offers no reset. Fix: collapse each city to one row that opens on tap, put the filters behind a single 'Filter' button on phones, and add 'Clear filters' to the empty state.

packages/web/src/app/planner/page.tsx:112-134: 'Open in route planner →' (?from=tour) still overwrites the band's saved sketch through savePlan, and the planner reschedules with its own rest rule, so the dates differ from the dashboard. 'Load my tour' and 'Clear' wipe the plan with no undo. Fix: keep the tour's real days, and add an undo toast after any replace or clear.

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:180-183: the Threshold tile still wraps '50% = 200 / fans' onto two lines (8-own-show.png), so the band's key number is the hardest to read. Fix: label the tile 'Goes ahead at', show '200 fans', and put '50% of the room' in the hint line.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:281-292: while a tour sells, 'New tour' is now outline, but the header still has three equal outline pills. On a phone they take two rows above the content (phone-home.png), and the 'A devnet demo at small scale…' paragraph under them is the first text a band reads. Fix: make 'Plan a route' and 'Track record' text links, and move the demo-scale note behind a small 'About this demo' disclosure.

qa/src/ui-bot.ts:248,410-445: the phone sweep still never captures the wizard's route preview or the band's own show page at 390 px. getSignaturesForAddress still returns [], so the real event feed in fans and euros never runs. Fix: add /tour/new after Plan my tour and /show?address=… to the phone sweep, and return a few signed events from the fake RPC.
